decisions.reason: As a multi-model naval lighting line still shown in 2024, it reflects meaningful engineering and certification investment in a specialist niche the firm publicly serves, so management is likely to persist unless results clearly collapse.

Although it received less prominent web treatment in 2024, this general interior luminaire line sits close to the firm's core building-lighting business and stated strategy, which makes withdrawal within a year relatively unlikely.

This pendant luminaire remains market-relevant and aligned with the firm's ergonomic and application-specific offer, but as a narrower single product it is somewhat easier to rationalize than the broader product lines.

Because the firm already discontinued another marine searchlight variant while retaining this multi-model line, management is likely to see F as the committed and strategically preferred marine offering and keep backing it.
